source: Read from the editor's skill timeline (战斗预设 > 技能 > 造物自定义技能 > 动画编辑) on 2026-10-11 with scripts/dev/animscrape.py and animparse.py, game version 7.x. Each row: id, name, seconds, 1 if it loops. 18 of the 48 complex creatures were read; incomplete lists those whose list may go on after the last id read.

seen.source: Looked at in play on 2026-10-11 and 12, frame by frame in recordings of the fitting room (examples/fitting), of examples/skirmish and of examples/kingdom6. atMs is the moment of the animation that counts (the blade lands, the hand opens): the graphAtMs of a skill that plays it.
seen.general: The models of complex creatures come with empty hands: no blade on 野伏, no crossbow on 火箭丘丘人, no gun on 火铳游击兵, no shield or axe on the 丘丘暴徒. What a creature holds is a looping effect that is a model, on its attachment point GI_WeaponR (GI_WeaponL for the left hand): mounted for good by a server graph (f.mountLoopingSpecialEffect(<effect>,creature,'GI_WeaponR',true,true,[0,0,0],[0,0,0],<scale>,false)) or shown by the skill for part of its animation (scene_add_creature_skill {effect:{asset,attachPoint,startMs,ms}}). The hand carries it properly in the animations made for that weapon and not in the others (a pickaxe hangs beside 盗宝团·斥候 while it throws; a bow never sits in its hand). The models that exist (effect_catalog {kind:"looping"}): 单手剑01-07, 双手剑01-07, 长柄武器01-05, 弓01-07, 法器01-07, 箭矢01, 丘丘人_弩箭, 盗宝团_飞刀_刀, 盗宝团_普通_镐, 矿镐, 人类_回声之子_鹤嘴锄, 菜刀, 锅铲; there is none for a crossbow, a gun, a shield, an axe or a club; 双手剑01 10002151, a dark slab of a blade, is the nearest thing to a crude one. So give a creature the attack its animations and these models can show: 野伏 a blade, 盗宝团·斥候 a thrown knife and a pickaxe, 打手丘丘人 its bare hands or a small cleaver, a 丘丘暴徒 a big one. Attack animations move the creature forward: every stroke of 打手丘丘人 1.2 to 1.4 m, the second cut of a 丘丘暴徒 nearly three, 野伏's leap three: end the pursuit that far from the target. A creature sent to a point behind it does not turn on the spot: it goes on in a wide turn first, about a metre walking and more than three running. So a creature that is to keep its place (before a wall that is not solid, say) needs strokes that end where they began: a stroke with a hop back after it in the same skill (animations ['攻击','闪避']), or only the part of an animation before its lunge (animationPortion); examples/kingdom6 does both. A creature does nothing for about four seconds after it is created.

creatures.30006009: Empty hands. Its ranged attack is a thrown knife, its work is digging with a pickaxe, its melee attack is bare-handed.
creatures.30008001: Empty hands; in the melee animations the right hand swings a blade: mount a 单手剑 on GI_WeaponR (单手剑01 10002152 at scale 1.4 fits this big man).
creatures.30007001: Empty hands. 无武器攻击 and 拳击 are bare-handed; in 攻击 and the 单手武器 animations the right hand raises a one-handed weapon over the head and brings it down. There is no club: 双手剑01 10002151 at scale 0.55 on GI_WeaponR looks like a crude cleaver in its hand (单手剑01 is held right too, but is a knight's sword).
creatures.30006001: Empty hands: its animations aim and fire a crossbow, which does not exist as a model.
creatures.30006008: Empty hands: its animations fire a gun, which does not exist as a model.
creatures.30005002: Empty hands: no axe. The right hand swings a big weapon in the melee animations: 双手剑01 10002151 at scale 1.2 on GI_WeaponR makes it a brute with a blade.

6009005.what: A thrown knife: the arm goes up with the knife (show 盗宝团_飞刀_刀 10006069 on GI_WeaponR for the first 2000 ms), the hand opens at about 2050 ms, the body is back by 3200 ms and only stands for the rest (animationPortion 0.62 leaves that out). In the air the knife is a projectile that carries 盗宝团_飞刀_刀 and 盗宝团_飞刀_尾迹 10006071 (examples/skirmish).

6009007.what: A swing with a pickaxe: up, then bent over the spot; the pick lands at about 700 ms. Show 盗宝团_普通_镐 10006070 on GI_WeaponR while it plays (effect ms 4400).

8001017.what: A cut and a turn, three to four metres forward; the first cut at roughly 550 ms (not timed closely). Its arc: 野伏众_近战攻击01_刀光 10016138.

8001018.what: A leap of about three metres with the blade over the head; it comes down at about 750 ms. Its arc: 野伏众_近战攻击02_刀光 10016139, played where the creature stands and turned as it is.

7001002.what: The right hand raises a one-handed weapon over the head (0.2 to 0.9 s) and brings it down in front with a short jump: it lands at about 1050 ms, about 1.3 m ahead of where it began.

7001005.what: A hop backwards of about three metres. After a stroke in the same skill it takes the creature back out of reach: strike, hop back, walk in again.

7001012.what: A blow with the bare hand: a lunge of a good metre, then half of it back; 900 ms was used and the number came up with the blow (not timed closely).

7001024.what: The right hand raises a one-handed weapon over the head and brings it down; 1.2 to 1.4 m forward a stroke.

7001025.what: A turn, a leap of about two metres and the one-handed weapon brought down on landing: it lands at about 1400 ms.

7001026.what: Three strokes with a one-handed weapon while it advances about four metres, at roughly 350, 900 and 1700 ms; over after two seconds, the rest is getting up. graphAtMs [350, 900, 1700] runs the skill's graph at each stroke (seen in play: three runs each time it played).

5002003.what: Two cuts with a big weapon in the right hand: a sweep that hardly moves the creature and lands at roughly 1300 ms (not timed closely), then from about 1.8 s a lunge of nearly three metres with the second cut; the body only recovers after 2.8 s. animationPortion 0.65 leaves the recovery out, 0.37 the lunge as well.

5002004.what: A leap of about three metres with the big weapon brought down on landing.

5002005.what: Cuts while it advances nearly three metres. A weapon mounted on GI_WeaponR leaves the hand in this one (it lay on the ground for a second): not for a creature that carries a mounted blade.
